name: Wedgemount Resources Corp.
summary: Wedgemount Resources Corp. is a Canadian enterprise focused on the discovery, assessment, and acquisition of mineral resources, primarily exploring for copper and gold deposits. The company holds significant interests in several British Columbia properties, including the 2,530-hectare Eagle property in the northern part of the province; the Cookie property, a substantial approximately 20,000-hectare tract located within the southern Toodoggone copper belt of north-central BC; and the Friendly Lake – Deer Lake copper-gold property, which encompasses 70 mineral claims across roughly 13,950 hectares in South-Central British Columbia. Established in 2020, Wedgemount Resources Corp. maintains its corporate headquarters in Garibaldi Highlands, Canada.
